dimensions.name: Day Type
dimensions.expr: CASE WHEN is_weekend THEN 'Weekend' ELSE 'Weekday' END

dimensions.name: Gender
dimensions.expr: CASE gender WHEN 'M' THEN 'Male' WHEN 'F' THEN 'Female' ELSE 'Unknown' END

dimensions.name: Age Group
dimensions.expr: CASE WHEN age < 18 THEN '0-17' WHEN age < 35 THEN '18-34' WHEN age < 50 THEN '35-49' WHEN age < 65 THEN '50-64' ELSE '65+' END

dimensions.name: Risk Segment
dimensions.expr: CASE WHEN critical_test_count > 0 THEN 'Critical' WHEN abnormal_test_count > 0 THEN 'Abnormal' WHEN total_tests > 0 THEN 'Normal' ELSE 'No Tests' END

datasets.name: patient_watchlist
queryLines:
SELECT patient_id,
  concat(first_name, ' ', last_name) AS patient_name,
  age,
  CASE gender WHEN 'M' THEN 'Male' WHEN 'F' THEN 'Female' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS gender,
  hospital_name,
  COALESCE(insurance_provider_name, 'Unknown') AS insurance_provider,
  total_tests,
  abnormal_test_count,
  critical_test_count,
  ROUND(abnormal_test_count / NULLIF(total_tests, 0), 3) AS abnormal_rate,
  last_test_date
FROM adb_caresync.gold.patient_360
WHERE critical_test_count > 0
ORDER BY critical_test_count DESC, abnormal_test_count DESC, last_test_date DESC
